title: SMOK Novo 6 Pod Vape Kit
description: The SMOK Novo 6 Pod Vape Kit represents a significant evolution for the pod kit that started it all. It maintains the pocket-friendly, slim profile and comfortable, wide mouthpiece that vapers love while significantly boosting internal performance. Designed for those who value both portability and power, the Novo 6 integrates a substantial 1700mAh battery into its compact chassis. This increased capacity ensures dependable endurance, capable of supporting the device's higher power output without the constant need for a charger. Offering a tailored experience, the Novo 6 features a clear 0.96-inch TFT colour display that allows for precise wattage adjustment between 5W and 40W. This variable power, combined with the stepless airflow slider, enables you to fine-tune your vape to perfection. Whether you prefer an intense yet discreet Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) draw or a rich and airy Restricted Direct-to-Lung (RDL) inhale, the Novo 6 adapts to your needs with ease. The kit continues to utilise the reliable SMOK Novo 5 pod platform. These pods are designed with a mess-free top-fill system, allowing you to refill by simply snapping off the mouthpiece cap without removing the pod from the device. Supplied with two 0.6ohm Meshed pods, the Novo 6 delivers rapid, even heating for consistent flavour, making it a sophisticated and practical choice for vapers of all experience levels. We recommend using 50/50 or Nic Salt E-Liquid with this kit Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
